newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S COMBINED DOWNHILL CALLED OFF.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S COMBINED DOWNHILL CALLED OFF.

text.p: The women's combined downhill at the Alpine skiing world championships was postponed on Friday because of bad weather.
The decision to postpone the race was made after officials had already delayed the start an hour because of wind and snow, which began falling overnight and dumped several centimetres on the piste.
The race jury said it would announce a new schedule at 1200 GMT.
The postponement could, in a worst-case scenario, extend the championships over to Sunday or Monday although that would cause major logistical problems for organisers.
